[SWS_DM_01457] SOVD data representation of arrays
⌈
The subset of a
SOVD request and response body matching a DiagnosticDataElement fulfilling
[TPS_DEXT_01001] shall be of type array with content type derived accordingly
to the atomic data definition. The JSON property maxItems shall be derived from
maxNumberOfElements of the DiagnosticDataElement.
⌋

[SWS_DM_01457] SOVD data representation of arrays
⌈
The subset of a SOVD request and response body matching a DiagnosticSovd-
ContentElement with DiagnosticSovdArrayContentElement shall be of type
array with content type derived according to DiagnosticSovdPrimitiveCon-
tentElement.swDataDefProps.
The JSON property maxItems shall be derived from DiagnosticSovdArray-
ContentElement.maxNumberOfElements of the DiagnosticSovdArrayCon-
tentElement.
